class.name: TimetableEntry
class.description: One line of the table ([code]TMTableLine[/code], [code]mtable.h:23-39[/code]). Times are hours since midnight, fractional; a negative arrival means the train passes without stopping.

method.name: is_stop
method.description: Whether the train stops here - an arrival time is given ([code]TTrainParameters::IsStop()[/code]).

members.member: When the train arrives, hours since midnight; -1 when it passes without stopping.
When the train departs, or passes, hours since midnight; -1 when left out.
The station's type and equipment, comma separated ([code]R4,RT,H,PP[/code], [code]@[/code] for a change of direction there).
Where the station is on the line [km].
The radio channel used from this station on, -1 for none given.
The station's name, [code]_[/code] in place of spaces, as the table writes it.
The tracks of the line, 1 or 2.
The running time to this station, minutes.
The timetable speed on the way to this station [km/h]; negative when unknown.
